fields.Name: W8 -> S3.4
fields.Description: Gate G2.27 (phase 2, dataset W8, criterion S3.4): with shuffled labels, the target-encoded high-cardinality feature of W8-highcard s42 scores no better than chance, 1 of 1: the 95% interval of the development rows' out-of-fold AUC does not lie above 0.5, and the held-out AUC's 95% interval covers 0.5. The gate exercises the sidecar's in-fold target encoder on a W8 snapshot built by the test fixture (the product's snapshot assembler emits one-hot encodings only, so a target-encoded column is not reachable from a product snapshot yet). It fails when the target encoder is fitted before the folds, on the development rows (the out-of-fold AUC interval lies above 0.5) or on all rows (the held-out interval excludes 0.5 too).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: With shuffled labels, a logistic regression on the in-fold target-encoded 400-level PostalCode of W8-highcard s42 scores no better than chance: the out-of-fold AUC's 95% Hanley-McNeil interval does not lie above 0.5 and the held-out AUC's interval covers 0.5 (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
